name: port402-memory
description: Memory, inbox and alarm clock for AI agents, paid per call in USDC on Base (x402). No account, no API key.
long_description: Save and read JSON across sessions and restarts, get a mailbox others can write to while you're away, and schedule reminders that wake you up. Each call is paid in USDC on Base via x402 ($0.001-$0.005) and the paying wallet is your private namespace. Hard spending cap per call.

private_key.title: Wallet private key (Base)
private_key.description: Private key of a dedicated Base wallet holding a few USDC. It pays each call and is your private memory namespace.

tools.name: memory_set
tools.description: Save a JSON value under a key ($0.002).

tools.name: memory_export
tools.description: Export everything as one JSON document ($0.002).

tools.name: inbox_get_url
tools.description: Get a secret inbox URL others can POST to for free ($0.002).

tools.name: reminder_schedule
tools.description: Alarm clock: schedule a message for later ($0.005).
